## What changed
- Maya is holding #247 until you give her the count of dropped Orbitly events for **Thursday's call with Orbitly**: 1,179,950 legitimate events, ≈8.1% of their iOS volume since 13/11. She approves as soon as CI is green [1][2].

## What you did
- Orbitly's ~8% iOS funnel drop is our own fault, not a replay: kestrel-ios 3.2.0 turned `event_id` into a per-session counter, so #240's dedupe threw away distinct events from different devices. Fix in PR #247 keys on project/device/event_id and still drops genuine replays [1].
- Zest Grocers' pilot store app runs the same SDK version and lost 3,812 events the same way; all other customers are unaffected [1].

## What is still open
- Once #247 is **deployed** (not just merged), replay Orbitly from landing for 13/11 onward (~40 min) and Zest (seconds), then verify `ingest_dedupe_dropped_total` for Orbitly stays near zero. Running it before deploy loses the events again [1].
- Your action item from the postmortem prep: alert when the ingest dead-letter queue exceeds 1,000 messages, **before Friday's incident review (20/11)** [7].
- The note to the iOS team is still a draft: `event_id` must go back to UUIDs in 3.2.1, since other consumers rely on the contract and this will recur [1].
